mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 0.5% quarter-over-quarter annualized signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in at least 70% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% month-over-month signals stronger manufacturing output, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in at least 65% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, increasing discount rates and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,400,000 units signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month sustained rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 persons signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in at least 65% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 2.0% signals easing inflationary pressures, which reduces the likelihood of aggressive Fed hikes and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in at least 65% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.
